=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- .github/workflows/cancel_on_pr_close.yml:354-377 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The new unlinked-run clause `(((.pull_requests // []) | length) == 0 and ($head_sha | test("^[0-9a-f]{40}$")) and .head_sha == $head_sha)` has no time bound (no created_at < closed_at check), so it cancels every queued or in-progress unlinked `pull_request` run on the closed PR's branch at its head SHA, including runs started by the same `closed` event (workflow-templates/ai-issue-pr-status.yml, and the post-merge run of workflow-templates/ai-review.yml).
  WHY: Every PR close loses the issue label/lineage sync, and every merge loses post-merge AI Review work (validate dispatch, force-poll), with no warning; tests/test_cancel_on_pr_close_closed_pr_runs.py has no case for this. Severity disagreement: sonnet, gemini and minimax rated BLOCKER, luna and glm rated MAJOR; the highest is used.
- .github/workflows/cancel_on_pr_close.yml:354-377 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: This is a backward-compatibility change for consumers: their close-event workflows (ai-issue-pr-status, and ai-review triggered on `closed`) used to survive Cancel on PR Close and are now cancelled, but agents.d/10049-merge-open-pr-guard.md and changelog.d/10049-merge-open-pr-guard.md do not mention it.
  WHY: Consumer repos that rely on these runs lose them without warning once the template ships. Sonnet says the created_at < closed_at fix resolves this; minimax says the change must be documented in both fragments.
- scripts/review_rb_judge.sh:2565-2616 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna]
  PROBLEM: In `rb_judge_merge_retry_transient`, a failed PR-state read clears `_rb_retry_state`, so the not-open check at line 2589 (`if [ -n "${_rb_retry_state}" ] && [ "${_rb_retry_state}" != "open" ]`) is skipped, and lines 2598-2599 send `gh pr merge ... --auto --match-head-commit` again without a state guard.
  WHY: If the PR is closed during the 10/20/40 s retry sleep and the next read fails, the judge still asks to merge it, which breaks Goal 4 ("fails closed when the state cannot be read"). Severity disagreement: luna rated BLOCKER, the others MAJOR; the highest is used. In its narration, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash judged this claim "actually mitigated" because unreadable reads pass `{}` to the guard and GitHub refuses `--auto` on a closed PR.
- scripts/review_rb_judge.sh:2795-2798 (also 2504-2517, 2907-2921, 3503-3512); scripts/pr_checks_lib.sh:837-911 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna]
  PROBLEM: When the first `--auto` merge fails, the direct fallback `rb_judge_sync_merge_guard && gh pr merge ... --match-head-commit` relies on `_pr_sync_merge_blocked_guard`. That guard reads only `.mergeable_state`, never `.state`, and returns 0 for any state other than blocked/unknown/none/unreadable, so a PR closed after the pre_merge check (line 2780) still passes.
  WHY: `--match-head-commit` binds only the head, so the direct (GH_PAT) merge of a closed PR reopens the #10049 race. Severity disagreement: sonnet NIT (conf 3), gemini MAJOR, minimax and luna BLOCKER; the highest is used. z-ai_glm-5_3-flash raised the same point only as a hardening suggestion.
- scripts/review_rb_judge.sh:2749-2790, 2872-2913, 3452-3480 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: In the merge, terminal and merge_with_followup chains, the only `_pr_merge_state_check` (pre_merge) runs after `_pr_base_fresh_for_merge` and `_pr_wait_for_required_checks`, and the judge has no start-stage check.
  WHY: `_pr_base_fresh_for_merge` can take the merge lease (`_merge_lease_gate` at scripts/pr_checks_lib.sh:2262 and 2303), update the branch and dispatch fresh CI before the guard refuses a closed PR, which violates Goal 2 and blocks PRs queued behind the lease. Severity disagreement: gemini MAJOR, minimax BLOCKER; the highest is used.
- scripts/review_merge_train.sh:2769-2780 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: `_mt_final_ci_merge_resume` calls `_pr_wait_for_required_checks` (line 2753), then `_pr_base_fresh_for_merge` (line 2769, which can take the lease), and only then `_pr_merge_state_check pre_merge` (line 2776); the poll tick has no start-stage check.
  WHY: A closed PR still takes the merge lease, blocks the merge train and may dispatch a final-CI run on the closed head before being deferred, which violates Goal 2.
- scripts/review_enable_auto_merge.sh:126-142 | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  PROBLEM: `read -r ready_label_pr_state ready_label_pr_draft ready_label_current_head_sha <<< "${ready_label_pr_fields}"` relies on positional parsing that can break.
  WHY: If the jq output changes (for example, empty fields), the variables can be assigned wrongly, which can cause unexpected branches or failures in the guard.
- scripts/pr_checks_lib.sh:4377-4383 | severity=low | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  PROBLEM: Failing closed when the state cannot be read (`reason=pr_state_unavailable`) can cause unnecessary retries.
  WHY: During transient network failures, PRs may be left in an uncertain state.
- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:1406-1414, 1420-1422 | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  PROBLEM: The fallback `_pr_merge_state_check` stub is defined unconditionally.
  WHY: Until the verified support library is updated, `start` checks only warn and proceed, and `pre_merge` checks fail closed, refusing to merge open PRs; this is a temporary regression during rollout.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===

  expected_change_site: scripts/review_rb_judge.sh merge / terminal `fix` / merge_with_followup paths (a `_pr_merge_state_check ... start` before `_pr_base_fresh_for_merge` at lines 2749, 2872, 3452); scripts/review_merge_train.sh `_mt_final_ci_merge_resume`
  confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  EVIDENCE: the judge's only new `_pr_merge_state_check` is pre_merge (lines 2780, 2903, 3469), after `_pr_base_fresh_for_merge` (2749/2766, 2872, 3452) and `_pr_wait_for_required_checks` (2761), and the judge has no start check; `_pr_base_fresh_for_merge` takes or asks for the lease and requests branch updates (pr_checks_lib.sh:2262, 2303); review_merge_train.sh:2769 calls `_pr_base_fresh_for_merge` before its only state check (2776/2777); agents.d/10049-merge-open-pr-guard.md lists only pre_merge sites for the judge and merge-train; the deterministic-skip step (review_autofix.yml:1514) and review_enable_auto_merge.sh:294 already have start checks

  EVIDENCE: Replay5800.test_final_ci_resume_on_a_closed_pr_merges_and_labels_nothing (tests/test_pr_merge_state_guard.py:167-182) replays only `_mt_final_ci_merge_resume` (scripts/review_merge_train.sh:2769-2795); the deterministic-skip step is covered only by substring-order checks in Wiring.test_deterministic_skip_step_checks_state_at_start_and_before_each_merge; no test shows no `gh pr merge`, exit 0, and no `ai:review-skipped` / `ai:ready-to-merge` label

=== FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===
- .github/workflows/cancel_on_pr_close.yml:lines 362-367 | severity=BLOCKER | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The unlinked-run clause `or (((.pull_requests // []) | length) == 0 and ($head_sha | test("^[0-9a-f]{40}$")) and .head_sha == $head_sha))` has no time bound, so it cancels runs started by the same `closed` event (workflow-templates/ai-issue-pr-status.yml:6; workflow-templates/ai-review.yml:19, 58). The only exclusions are at lines 369-373, and `_cpr_fetch_active_runs` (lines 178-210) has no created_at filter.
  WHY: On every close, the Issue PR Status run and the post-merge AI Review run are cancelled, so the label/lineage sync and the post-merge validate dispatch are lost. No test covers this. Suggested fix: add `PR_CLOSED_AT`, `--arg closed_at`, and `($closed_at | test("^[0-9]{4}-")) and ((.created_at // "") < $closed_at)`.
- scripts/review_rb_judge.sh:rb_judge_merge_retry_transient, lines 2565-2577, line 2589, lines 2598-2599 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: A failed re-read clears `_rb_retry_state`, so the not-open check is skipped and `gh pr merge --auto` is sent again.
  WHY: A PR closed during the retry sleep (up to 70 s) can still get a merge request, which breaks Goal 4; `--match-head-commit` binds only the head. Fix: treat an empty `_rb_retry_state` as fail-closed (`RB_MERGE_RETRY_GIVEUP="deferred"; return 1`).
- scripts/review_rb_judge.sh, scripts/pr_checks_lib.sh:review_rb_judge.sh:2795-2797; pr_checks_lib.sh:870-903 | severity=NIT | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: `_pr_sync_merge_blocked_guard` makes a fresh `pulls/<n>` GET (line 864) right before the direct merge but never checks `.state`.
  WHY: A PR closed between the state check at line 2780 and the direct merge passes the guard, which reopens a narrow version of the #10049 race. Fix: defer when `.state` is set and not "open".
